```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The US political and economic system is failing the working class.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions struggle with low wages, dangerous working conditions, and limited control over their own lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The top one percent has gotten richer and richer.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Billionaires control access to basic human needs like housing, healthcare, and education and make a profit off of them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This capitalist economic system is the cause of violence, unemployment, and a climate crisis that poses an existential threat to life on earth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Black and brown workers in racially segregated communities bear the brunt of capitalism’s cruelties.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Black and brown workers in racially segregated communities suffer especially from poverty wages, discrimination, deportation, and unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Poverty wages, discrimination, deportation, and unemployment often push workers into illegal activity to survive.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Instead of investing in working-class communities, capitalists prefer to police and incarcerate workers they consider expendable to protect their wealth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Accelerating declines in living standards are exploited by the Christian nationalist right and figures like Donald Trump.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans rejected the far-right agenda in the 2020 elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans watched a failed coup attempt to overturn the 2020 election results.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The far-right threatens Americans’ civil liberties.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The far-right attacks the right of people to decide whether to have a kid by overturning Roe v. Wade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The far-right continues to restrict abortion access.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The far-right attacks the rights of queer and transgender people by banning gender-affirming care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These culture wars are intended to pit workers against each other to empower a right-wing government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
